title: Replay determinism is a check (`hunch serve replay`), not a claim: the ledger folded into the state it implies must match the records on file hash for hash
context: The ROADMAP landscape table and dec_a80438754d (proposed, private) asked for a published command proving that a partition's current state is a pure function of its change ledger — Neotoma's strongest verifiable claim (fnd_f670868a8c) — rather than copy asserting it. The ledger (nuryel.ledger/1) carries per-event record hashes and a whole idempotency table, but no record bodies; git-tracked JSON stays the source of truth (con_a87360128b family).
decision: Add `verifyReplay` (src/store/replay.ts, nuryel.replay/1) and `hunch serve replay --partition <kind:id> | --root <dir>`: fold the ledger to the last event per record, compare each record's stateHash (sha256 over canonical form, so equal hashes are byte-equal canonical records) to the record on file, and fingerprint both sides (replay_hash / stored_hash over the facets the contract owns). Divergences are typed — missing-record, hash-drift, orphan-record (a state record the ledger never saw: the crash-between-put-and-append the ledger promised the next writer could detect), idempotency-drift — plus legacy-drift for decisions/constraints/bugs/findings moved by pre-contract paths (reported, never a failure). Exit 1 on any failing divergence. Compaction keeps the property through the idempotency table (kept whole); a closed record whose supersession fell below the floor is `unverifiable` (counted, not failed), an open record that differs is drift. The agent farm replays every served partition at the end of every run and reports `replay`. Run read-only on 2026-09-09 against a live user partition and both emulation organization drawers: all three equal, 0 divergences.
consequences: A one-command proof for docs and CI: same ledger, same state, exit code.
Any future write path that touches a state-kind record must append to the ledger, or the replay check names it as an orphan.
Compaction and merge must preserve replay equivalence; the farm run enforces it every test run.
alternatives_rejected: Store record bodies in the ledger so a partition can be rebuilt byte-for-byte without the files — REJECTED: doubles the git-tracked footprint of every derived summary (up to 20k chars each) and makes the ledger a second source of truth; the hash over canonical bytes gives the same guarantee against the files that already exist.

Treat every below-floor mismatch as drift — REJECTED: closing a window on supersession is the one contract change without an idempotency entry, so a closed record below the floor is legitimately unverifiable; failing it would make compaction unsafe.

Fail on legacy-facet drift — REJECTED: decisions are also moved by `hunch supersede`, adopt-drafts and captures in a repository partition; those are not contract writes, so their drift is reported, not failed.
